announcement_evidence.announcement_text: SentinelOne, Inc. - SentinelOne Announces Date of Fiscal Third Quarter 2027 Financial Results Conference Call and Participation in Upcoming Investor Conference Skip to main content Overview Press Releases Events & Presentations Financial Info Quarterly Results SEC Filings Governance Governance Documents Management Board of Directors Committee Composition Whistleblower Hotline Resources Investor Email Alerts Investor FAQs Investor Contacts Blog Skip to main content News Details Overview Press Releases Events & Presentations Financial Info Quarterly Results SEC Filings Governance Governance Documents Management Board of Directors Committee Composition Whistleblower Hotline Resources Investor Email Alerts Investor FAQs Investor Contacts Blog View All News SentinelOne Announces Date of Fiscal Third Quarter 2027 Financial Results Conference Call and Participation in Upcoming Investor Conference November 12, 2026 MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- SentinelOne, Inc. (NYSE: S) today announced that it will release financial results for its fiscal third quarter 2027, which ended October 31, 2026. Results will be released after market close on Thursday, December 3, 2026. SentinelOne will host a conference call to discuss the results at 2:00 p.m. PT (5:00 p.m. ET) on the same day. To register for the live event, please visit Q3 FY2027 Earnings Conference Call Webcast . SentinelOne is also scheduled to present at the following investor conference: Event: Barclays Global Technology Conference Date: Thursday, December 10, 2026 Presentation Time: 12:50 p.m. PT (3:50 p.m. ET) Live webcasts for both events will be available on SentinelOne’s Investor Relations website at investors.sentinelone.com , along with related earnings materials. Replays will be accessible through the same link shortly after each event. Disclosure Information SentinelOne uses, and intends to continue using, its Investor Relations website ( investors.sentinelone.com ) as a means of disclosing material information to the public and complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Accordingly, investors should monitor the Investor Relations website, in addition to the company’s press releases, blog ( sentinelone.com/blog ), SEC filings, public conference calls, presentations, and webcasts. About SentinelOne SentinelOne (NYSE: S) is the leader in AI security, setting the standard for leveraging AI and automation to give defenders a decisive operating advantage. Built for those who secure our world, Singularity Platform delivers unified coverage across endpoints, identity, cloud, and AI. Powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence, SentinelOne stops attacks at machine speed, reducing risk and delivering clarity and control to stay one step ahead. Headquartered in Mountain View, California with teams worldwide, SentinelOne protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500 and hundreds of Global 2000 enterprises. From Main Street to Wall Street, the world’s most critical organizations trust SentinelOne for cybersecurity.
